inputs.description: Use the original preprocessed/binned neural firing for all six tones and both laser conditions: PPC inputs for Figure 3C and PPC/PUL inputs specified by the Figure 3G legend. metric.description: The primary quantities are the original per-session laser-OFF and laser-ON prevalence-decoding ROC-AUCs, their paired ON-minus-OFF contrasts and the source paired-session statistical comparisons, kept separately for Figures 3C and 3G. full_panel.description:
Named primary: complete original Figure 3C PUL-suppression and Figure 3G TRN-activation perturbation-versus-control prevalence-decoding contrasts. Preserve panel-specific neural inputs, all six tone identities, 17 and 20 reported sessions, paired OFF/ON values and ON-minus-OFF contrasts, original session/condition/animal identities, source training/held-trial procedure, windows excluding manipulation and shuffled-label comparator. The four retained signed-direction/P findings are genuine partial source summaries; native numerical AUC and paired-contrast vectors and their exact support remain unrecovered and require structured-output support. The released Figure 3G census has 18 groups, not the paper 20. S6M/N and S7A constrain broader mechanism claims but are not claimed reproduced or automatically added to this named panel; SHAP, Figure 3H pseudopopulations, behavior and RNN results are neither substitutes nor automatic additions.

Retained source-specific qualifications:
Reproduce the original Figure 3C and Figure 3G findings that PUL suppression and TRN activation reduce neuronal decoding of recent tone prevalence relative to their paired non-laser controls. Retain both named biological perturbation panels. Candidate-versus-author decoder superiority is a separately named empirical method extension and cannot substitute for reproduction or improvement of this finding.
